jobs.occupation: Director, Sales Operations DACH (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

jobs.occupation: Office Manager & Team Assistance (m/f/d) (Office-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

At TYTAN, every mission starts with a first impression, and that's where you come in. As our Office Manager and Team Assistant you are the face and the heartbeat of our Berlin representation. You'll be the first point of contact for guests and partners. You will shape the daily rhythm of the office, create a welcoming environment for our international team, and ensure that everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, including day-to-day support for the team and leadership.
As a young, fast-growing scale-up, we need someone who's comfortable wearing many hats and moving fluidly between office management, team support, and personal assistance to our team lead, depending on what the day brings.

Your roadmap to make an impact:

- Be the ambassador of TYTAN: warmly welcome visitors, partners, and new hires, ensuring they feel the unique spirit of our company from the moment they arrive.
- Keep operations flowing: oversee office organization, supplies, vendor coordination, and facility management to ensure a smooth daily workflow.
- Support leadership and teams: assist with scheduling, travel arrangements, and meeting coordination.
- Provide personal assistance to the team lead and keep the team running: manage calendars, coordinate travel, prepare meetings, and handle recurring personal and organizational matters with discretion.
- Create a vibrant workplace culture: organize events, foster a positive office atmosphere, and help maintain a space where collaboration thrives.
- Be the connector: act as the go-to person for day-to-day questions, guiding colleagues and visitors through processes with clarity and care.

Job requirements

- You bring experience in office management, administration, or a PA role.
- You are a people person: approachable, professional, and always ready to support colleagues and guests with a smile.
- You have excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with an eye for detail, and you enjoy taking ownership of organizational tasks.
- You are fluent in German and English, both spoken and written.
- You thrive in dynamic, young teams and enjoy wearing multiple hats.
- Experience with office tools (MS Office, HR/admin systems).

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

- Provide bilingual (German/English) user support via phone, Teams, email, and remote sessions, translating technical issues into clear guidance

- Experience with ITSM tools (Freshservice, Freshdesk) and endpoint imaging/MDM solutions
- Familiarity with SOC/SIEM tools or incident response processes
- Experience with network printers and enterprise print environments

What We Offer

- A flat hierarchy with short decision-making paths and a highly collaborative team culture
- Access to employee benefits such as Wellpass or Sodexo

jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Development Manager – Distribution Partners Germany, EMEA Partner Organization (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.

The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.

As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.

Key job responsibilities
Partner Management & Strategy
• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.
• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.
• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.
• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.

Revenue & Performance Management
• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.
• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.
• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.
• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.
• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.

Program Design & Execution
• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs.
.
• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.

Enablement & Ecosystem Growth
• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.
• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.
• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.

About the team
The Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background
- German and English business fluent
- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems
- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation
- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability
- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisations

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)
- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience
- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)
- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement
- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch
- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscape

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

jobs.occupation: Advisor Tax (f/m/d) / 1630 (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description:
Our tax team of six, led by our Head of Tax, covers the tax matters of all group companies worldwide. To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.

Tasks

- Preparing tax balance sheets and tax returns for the German group companies together with our colleagues.
- Support in preparing and maintaining our transfer pricing documentation (Master File, Local Files, CbCR), including functional and risk analyses.
- Contributing to the implementation and further development of intercompany transfer pricing guidelines and models and reviewing intercompany agreements in coordination with the business functions.
- Tax assessment of business transactions, contracts and restructurings.
- Advising business functions and subsidiaries on tax matters, and acting as contact person for our foreign entities on operational questions regarding the operational application of transfer pricing requirements.
- Supporting tax audits and communicating with tax authorities and external advisors.
- Helping us develop our Tax Compliance Management System further and digitalise our tax processes.
- Monitoring legislative changes and case law, and deriving recommendations for action.

Qualifications

- Academic track record with a finance and international tax background.
- At least three years of professional experience in tax consultancy, audit, or an in-house tax function; experience in the tax department of a multinational group is an advantage.
- German Tax Advisor Exam is an advantage.
- Sound knowledge of German corporate income tax law; knowledge of international tax law is desirable.
- Initial exposure to transfer pricing, or a clear interest in building expertise in this area.
- Experience with SAP and common tax software, along with very good Excel skills.
- Structured and independent way of working, and enjoyment of working with different business functions.
- Business-fluent German and good English language skills.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: First Research Article Fellowship Program (Forschungsreferent/in)
jobs.description:
First Research Article Fellowship Program at the Max Planck Institute for the History

of Science, Berlin

01 September 2027 – 28 February 2028

The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science ( MPIWG) is offering six-month

fellowships for outstanding graduate students enrolled in doctoral programs based at

Asian, African, or Latin American institutions.

Applicants should demonstrate their commitment to a research topic related to the history of

science, technology, and medicine, or science and technology studies, and a need to work

with an international community at the MPIWG in order to prepare and publish their first

single-authored research paper in English.

First Research Article Fellows will be hosted in one of the following departments:

• Artefacts, Action, Knowledge (AAK – Director: Prof. Dr. Dagmar Schäfer)

• Knowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL – Director: Prof. Dr. Etienne Benson)

Regular meetings will be held to support both the writing process and academic

development. Fellows are welcome and encouraged to take part in activities offered by the

Institute and by the International Max Planck Research School “Knowledge and Its

Resources” that take place on our campus.

Candidates are expected to have already completed the relevant research for their thesis and

be in a position to devote six months to writing and preparing an article in English for

journal publication. Fellows must remain enrolled in their home institution’s doctoral

program through the end of the advertised fellowship period.

Fellowships are endowed with a monthly stipend according to the guidelines of the Max

Planck Society (https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-

fellowship).

Applicants should submit the following materials in English through our online application

portal:

1. Cover letter explaining how the applicant’s proposed research fits the research

themes of one specific department

1. Official enrollment certificate and confirmation that the applicant will remain

enrolled in an accredited graduate program (PhD) through the end of the

fellowship

1. 500-word description of the dissertation written by the applicant
2. Curriculum vitae (preferably without a photograph) including any publications if

applicable

1. Title, abstract, and outline of article to be completed during the fellowship

(maximum 750 words)

1. English-language writing sample (maximum 8000 words including notes and

bibliography) written by the applicant7. A letter of recommendation from one supervisor

This program is intended to support scholars who wish to improve their academic English.

We encourage you to write your application without the use of AI.

The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science encourages applications from qualified

individuals who belong to groups that are often underrepresented in the workplace due to age,

disability, ethnicity, family status, gender, nationality, race, sex, sexual orientation,

socioeconomic background, or religion.

Please note that only electronic submissions will be accepted. Applications must be

uploaded to the following link on or before 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET):

https://recruitment.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/position/36470793

Finalists may expect a decision by 1 April 2027.

Descriptions of the research projects undertaken by the departments can be found here:

Artifacts, Action, Knowledge (AAK):

https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/artifacts-action-knowledge

Knowledge Systems and Collective Life (KSCL):

https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/department/knowledge-systems-collective-life

For further information, please consult the Frequently Asked Questions at the program’s

website: https://www.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/research/projects/first-research-article-

fellowship.

For all other questions, contact the Publications Manager for this program, Lindy

Divarci                 divarci@mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de

Max Planck Institute for the History of Science

Boltzmannstr. 22, 14195 Berlin

Germany

jobs.occupation: Manufacturing & Industrialization Engineer (Produktionsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Manufacturing & Industrialisation Engineer, you will help turn our proprietary solar-thermal technology into scalable, repeatable production systems that can be deployed around the world.

This is a hands-on technical role spanning two unique manufacturing environments: component production through external manufacturing partners, and the construction of large solar fields as disciplined, measurable production systems. Working with experienced colleagues, suppliers and project teams, you will contribute from early concepts and specifications through supplier delivery, commissioning, ramp-up and continuous improvement, taking increasing ownership as your capability grows.

Your Impact

Your work will help turn innovative engineering into reliable production and large-scale deployment.

You’ll shape how our technology is manufactured and deployed—from developing production processes and equipment to improving how solar fields are built in the field. Working across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, you’ll help create safer, more efficient and repeatable ways of delivering our technology at scale.

What You'll Do

Develop Manufacturing Processes

- Support senior engineers in developing production concepts, equipment specifications, technical evaluations, trials and acceptance plans.
- Take increasing ownership of defined manufacturing processes, tooling packages, supplier actions and site-production workstreams as your capability grows.
- Develop manufacturing processes, machine concepts and equipment specifications for GlassPoint's proprietary concentrating mirrors and film panels.
- Apply DFMA, process capability, standard work, line balancing, cycle-time and capacity analysis to improve safety, quality, output and cost.

Build Tools and Production Systems

- Create clear process documentation, work instructions, layouts, standard work and equipment records.
- Help turn solar-field construction into a repeatable field-production system with defined workflows, work packages, tooling, crew structures and productivity measures.
- Develop or specify production equipment, tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges and handling solutions suited to factories and remote sites.
- Choose the right level of automation - from simple manual aids through mechanised tooling to automated equipment - based on volume, workforce capability, maintainability and economics.

Build Tools and Production Systems

- Work with external equipment builders, integrators and manufacturing partners through technical evaluation, design review, FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up.
- Collect and analyse process data, cycle times, defects, downtime and labour productivity, turning evidence into practical improvement actions.
- Work across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, capturing lessons and improving each subsequent deployment.

Commission and Continuously Improve 

- Collect and analyse process data, cycle times, defects, downtime and labour productivity, turning evidence into practical improvement actions.
- Work across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Delivery, Construction and HSE, capturing lessons and improving each subsequent deployment.

Who You Are

You’re a practical and curious engineer who wants to understand how products are made, how production systems work and how they can be improved.

You enjoy learning through direct experience in factories, supplier facilities and project sites. You’re reliable, adaptable and comfortable working through engineering problems, analysing data and getting hands-on with production processes and equipment. You’re ready to learn from experienced colleagues and take increasing ownership as your capability grows.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- Degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Typically 10+ years of relevant manufacturing or industrialisation experience, with direct responsibility for production processes, equipment or line deployment.
- A strong record of specifying, procuring, commissioning and ramping production machinery, tooling or automated/semi-automated systems.
- Experience leading engineers, project teams or technical workstreams; formal people-management experience is desirable.
- Deep practical knowledge of DFMA, process capability, tolerancing, error-proofing, line balancing, standard work and continuous improvement.
- Confidence working with equipment builders, system integrators and outsourced manufacturers, including FAT and SAT.
- Experience with large assemblies, modular systems, construction operations or field-deployed production is highly desirable.
- Practical, commercially aware and comfortable making structured decisions with incomplete information.
- Strong English communication skills and willingness to travel internationally, sometimes for extended project phases.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security. We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

jobs.description:
As a Test Development Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of technology that healthcare professionals rely on every day.
Working at the intersection of hardware, software, and manufacturing, you will design and develop automated test solutions that help deliver high-quality medical devices to patients around the world in close collaboration with engineers across R&D, quality and manufacturing.

This is a fixed term position till September 2028

Your role:

- Developing automated production tests for our patient monitoring portfolio in close collaboration with R&D during the product development lifecycle.
- Designing and implementing innovative test solutions, including test hardware, fixtures, instrumentation, and test software.
- Creating test concepts from component and PCB level up to complete manufacturing test systems.
- Analyzing measurement data and continuously optimize test coverage, reliability, and efficiency.
- Validating, verifying, and documenting test systems in compliance with medical device regulations and quality standards.
- Supporting global production sites by maintaining and improving deployed test systems.
- Driving innovation in our test development platform through modern engineering practices, automation, digitalization, and AI-assisted development approaches.

You're the right fit if:

- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Technical Informatics, or a related engineering discipline.
- You have experience in electronics development, hardware testing, measurement technology, or test system development.
- You possess solid knowledge of analog and digital electronics, signal conditioning, sensor interfaces, and high-speed signals.
- You enjoy working hands-on with measurement equipment and solving complex technical challenges.
- You have programming experience in environments such as Python, Go, LabVIEW, TestStand, or similar technologies.
- You are comfortable using modern AI tools and coding assistants such as GPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies to increase productivity and innovation.
- You communicate effectively in English and German and enjoy working in an international environment.
- You are curious, open-minded, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies.
- You take ownership, enjoy working independently, and are equally comfortable collaborating within a team.
- Most importantly, you are passionate about engineering and motivated to make a real impact on products that help improve and save lives every day.
- Knowledge of medical device development, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, verification, or validation processes is an advantage but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €93,050.83 – €124,067.77. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. An entry-level position below this range may be offered if the job requirements are not yet fully met; in this case, the employee will be placed in a lowersalary band. We ensure compliance with internal compensation structures as well as standard market conditions.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

Benefits include: 

- Annual leave: 30 days  
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…) 
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare 
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan  
- Philips “Partnerzeit”: two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth 
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products  
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.  

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
